name: CK Life Sciences Int'l., (Holdings) Inc.
summary: CK Life Sciences Int'l., (Holdings) Inc., an investment holding company, researches, develops, manufactures, commercializes, and sells health and agriculture-related products in the Asia Pacific and North America. It manufactures and markets plant protection products and soluble fertilizers; manufactures, blends, distributes, trades, and sells fertilizers, pesticides, and related agricultural products; manufactures and distributes horticultural products for the home gardening market; and produces non-sterile prescription and over-the-counter medicines.
